title: Changelog #0009
summary: Internal progress, preparing automated template induction for production, and a shoutout to our favorite tools.
body_markdown:
Happy Friday!


Nothing user-facing to report in this week’s changelog, so hang tight.


We continue to invest in internal tooling: evals, infra rewrite, and prepping last week’s[automatic template induction POC](https://blog.butter.dev/changelog-0008#heading-automatic-template-induction) for production.


For fun, here’s a shout-out for some of the tools we’ve been using and loving:


-


[Bun](http://bun.sh/) for runtime and tests.


-


[E2B](http://e2b.dev/) for TS sandboxing.


-


[Braintrust](http://braintrust.dev/) for evals.


-


[Vercel](https://ai-sdk.dev/docs/introduction) AI SDK for structured generation.


-


And of course,[Butter](http://butter.dev/) for caching tests and evals - it’s really sped up our iteration cycles to have LLM requests return 20x faster.


Stay tuned next week for more updates!
